decision: Keep Phase0 open; retain all negative evidence. Run one fixed-duration no-ML sampler control before selecting any lifecycle fix.
limitations: Temporal association does not identify the process causing system-wide swap.
Host timestamps are recorded after acquisition; boundary associations and uncovered margins remain ambiguous.
The owner role includes unmanaged descendants; process identity does not prove model or tensor ownership.
Process RSS and Metal must not be added together.
The previous 103-second smoke had no stage timings and a different preceding run order; counts and latency are not a causal A/B comparison.
Snapshot acquisition timing excludes diagnostic callback and scheduling; callback overhead was not separately measured.
